senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: Facts or information showing that something is true.
A printed or digital copy checked before final publication.
Able to resist damage or effects from something.

ex.en: Keep your receipt as proof that you paid.
ex.zh: 保留收据，作为你已付款的凭证。

ex.en: Governments should require clear proof of a treatment's effectiveness before allowing it to be widely marketed.
ex.zh: 政府应要求提供治疗方法有效的明确证据，才允许其大范围上市推广。

tip: 表示证据时通常不可数；数学证明可用a proof。

senses.en: things that belong to a person or organisation
land or buildings that someone owns
a quality of a substance or material

ex.en: Please keep your personal property safe while you swim.
ex.zh: 游泳时，请妥善保管个人财物。

ex.en: Understanding the thermal properties of building materials helps architects design homes that require less heating.
ex.zh: 了解建筑材料的热学性能，有助于建筑师设计供暖需求更低的住宅。

tip: 财产义不可数；房产和性质义可数。

senses.en: the act of keeping someone or something safe from harm

ex.en: This thick coat offers protection against the cold wind.
ex.zh: 这件厚外套能抵御寒风。

ex.en: Stronger environmental laws are essential for the protection of endangered species and their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 更严格的环境法律对于保护濒危物种及其自然栖息地至关重要。

tip: 通常不可数；protection from/against表示免受伤害。

senses.en: An expression or action showing strong disagreement or opposition.
Express strong disagreement with something.

ex.en: Residents held a peaceful protest outside the town hall.
ex.zh: 居民在市政厅外举行了一场和平抗议。

ex.en: Citizens may protest against environmental policies that fail to protect local forests and water supplies.
ex.zh: 公民可能会抗议那些未能保护当地森林和水源的环境政策。

tip: 所列为名词音；动词英音/prəˈtest/，常接against。

senses.en: Show that something is true using evidence
Turn out to be a particular thing or quality

ex.en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。

ex.en: Long-term studies may prove that regular exercise improves concentration as well as physical health.
ex.zh: 长期研究可能证实，经常锻炼既能改善注意力，也能增强身体健康。

col: prove a point｜证明一个观点
prove someone wrong｜证明某人错了
tip: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

senses.en: to produce books or other writing for public reading
to make information officially available to the public

ex.en: The local magazine published my photograph of the river.
ex.zh: 当地杂志刊登了我拍摄的河流照片。

ex.en: Researchers should publish their findings openly so that policymakers can make decisions based on reliable evidence.
ex.zh: 研究人员应公开发表研究结果，让政策制定者能够依据可靠证据作出决策。

tip: publish强调向公众发行或公布，不等于仅仅印刷。

senses.en: make someone face an unpleasant consequence for doing wrong

ex.en: The referee punished the player for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 裁判因那名球员违反规则而对其作出处罚。

ex.en: Schools should explain why behaviour is unacceptable rather than simply punish students without offering guidance.
ex.zh: 学校应解释为何某种行为不可接受，而不是只惩罚学生却不给予引导。

col: punish someone for something｜因某事惩罚某人
tip: punish sb for sth表示因某事惩罚某人。

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。

ex.en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
ex.zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。

tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

senses.en: the reason for doing something or what something is intended for
a feeling of having meaningful aims in life

ex.en: What is the purpose of this tiny kitchen tool?
ex.zh: 这个小小的厨房工具是做什么用的？

ex.en: The main purpose of public libraries is to provide equal access to information and learning opportunities.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆的主要目的是让人们平等地获取信息和学习机会。

tip: on purpose意为“故意地”，不是“有目的地”。

senses.en: An exercise raising and lowering your body using your arms.

ex.en: I managed one push-up before my arms started shaking.
ex.zh: 我做了一个俯卧撑，胳膊就开始发抖了。

ex.en: Simple exercises such as push-ups allow people to build strength without paying for expensive gym memberships.
ex.zh: 俯卧撑等简单运动让人们无需支付昂贵的健身房会员费就能增强力量。

col: a set of push-ups｜一组俯卧撑
tip: 可数名词；英式英语也常用press-up。

senses.en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

tip: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: a structure with triangular sides meeting at a point
a system with fewer members at each successively higher level

ex.en: We built a small pyramid out of wooden blocks.
ex.zh: 我们用木块搭了一座小金字塔。

ex.en: The management pyramid in many organisations places a small group of executives above numerous employees.
ex.zh: 许多机构的金字塔式管理结构将少数高管置于众多员工之上。

tip: 既指古代金字塔，也指几何中的棱锥体。

senses.en: An official award showing successful completion of education or training.
A skill or quality making someone suitable for a role.
A condition that limits the meaning or acceptance of something.

ex.en: This qualification helped me find work at a nursery.
ex.zh: 这个资格证书帮助我在一家幼儿园找到了工作。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value practical experience alongside formal qualifications when recruiting graduates for demanding professional roles.
ex.zh: 招聘毕业生担任要求较高的专业岗位时，雇主越来越重视实际经验与正式学历。

tip: 谈学历或资历常用复数qualifications。

senses.en: the amount or number of something

ex.en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。

ex.en: Reducing the quantity of food wasted by households could lower both environmental damage and living costs.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量，既能减轻环境损害，也能降低生活成本。

col: quality over quantity｜质量优于数量
tip: quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。

senses.en: A set of written questions used to collect information from people.

ex.en: Please complete this short questionnaire before leaving the clinic.
ex.zh: 离开诊所前，请填写这份简短的问卷。

ex.en: Researchers distributed a questionnaire to investigate how commuting time affects workers' wellbeing and satisfaction with their jobs.
ex.zh: 研究人员发放了问卷，调查通勤时间如何影响员工的幸福感和工作满意度。

tip: 双n，重音在末尾；survey指调查，问卷只是其工具。

senses.en: words repeated exactly from another person or source
a statement of the expected price of goods or services

ex.en: She opened her speech with a quotation from a poem.
ex.zh: 她引用了一句诗作为演讲的开场白。

ex.en: Before selecting a contractor, local authorities should obtain a detailed quotation for the proposed construction work.
ex.zh: 在选择承包商之前，地方政府应获取拟议建筑工程的详细报价。

tip: 引语来自某人或作品用from；报价常接for。

senses.en: To repeat someone's exact words in speech or writing.
To state the price you will charge for something.
Repeated words from a source, or a stated price.

ex.en: My sister loves to quote lines from old films.
ex.zh: 我姐姐很喜欢引用老电影里的台词。

ex.en: Students should quote reliable sources accurately and explain how the evidence supports their arguments in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学生在学术论文中应准确引用可靠来源，并解释证据如何支持自己的论点。

col: quote someone a price｜向某人报价
tip: quote引用原话；paraphrase用自己的话转述。

senses.en: The sport of competing to move faster than others.
Designed or used for races.

ex.en: My cousin enjoys watching bicycle racing on weekend afternoons.
ex.zh: 我表亲喜欢在周末下午看自行车比赛。

ex.en: Professional motor racing encourages technological innovation, but its environmental impact remains a subject of debate.
ex.zh: 职业赛车运动推动技术创新，但其环境影响仍存在争议。

tip: 作运动名称通常不可数；一场比赛用a race。

senses.en: An object with strings used to hit balls in sports.
A loud, unpleasant noise.

ex.en: I left my tennis racket beside the court.
ex.zh: 我把网球拍落在球场边了。

ex.en: Providing basic equipment, such as a racket, can make school sports more accessible to children.
ex.zh: 提供球拍等基本器材，可以让更多孩子参与学校体育活动。

tip: 球拍也可拼作racquet；喧闹声只用racket。

senses.en: Travelling down a river on a raft for pleasure.

ex.en: We went rafting down a mountain river last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末我们去一条山间河流漂流了。

ex.en: Rafting can support rural tourism, but operators must provide safety equipment and protect river habitats.
ex.zh: 漂流可以促进乡村旅游，但经营者必须提供安全装备并保护河流栖息地。

tip: 运动义常用go rafting；raft也指筏子。

senses.en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train
a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier
to complain angrily and strongly about something

ex.en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
ex.zh: 我们乘火车穿过了白雪覆盖的群山。

ex.en: Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.
ex.zh: 投资铁路基础设施可以缓解道路拥堵，并提供比国内航班更环保的出行选择。

col: hold onto the rail｜抓住扶手
tip: by rail表示乘火车，不加冠词；动词常接against。

senses.en: a curved band of colours appearing in the sky after rain
a collection or range of many different colours

ex.en: A bright rainbow appeared above the hills after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，群山上空出现了一道鲜艳的彩虹。

ex.en: Tourists often photograph the rainbow that forms in the spray near the base of the waterfall.
ex.zh: 游客经常拍摄瀑布底部附近水雾中形成的彩虹。

col: a rainbow of colours｜缤纷的色彩
tip: 通常是可数名词；a rainbow of表示色彩缤纷的一系列。

senses.en: a dense forest in an area receiving very heavy rainfall

ex.en: We spotted colourful birds high in the rainforest canopy.
ex.zh: 我们在雨林高高的树冠层中发现了色彩鲜艳的鸟儿。

ex.en: Protecting tropical rainforest helps preserve biodiversity and prevents large amounts of stored carbon from entering the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护热带雨林有助于维护生物多样性，并防止大量储存的碳进入大气。

tip: 常写作rainforest；rain forest也正确。

senses.en: not common or not happening often
cooked briefly so the inside remains red

ex.en: We spotted a rare bird beside the lake yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在湖边发现了一只罕见的鸟。

ex.en: Protecting rare species requires long-term investment in habitat restoration and effective controls on illegal trade.
ex.zh: 保护稀有物种需要长期投资于栖息地修复，并有效管制非法贸易。

tip: rare形容肉时指内部仍红，熟度低于medium。

senses.en: a rodent with a long tail, larger than a mouse

ex.en: A rat disappeared behind the bins near the gate.
ex.zh: 一只大鼠钻到大门附近的垃圾桶后面，不见了。

ex.en: Proper waste management helps control rat populations and reduces health risks in densely populated neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 妥善管理垃圾有助于控制鼠群数量，并降低人口密集社区的健康风险。

tip: rat通常指大鼠，mouse通常指体型较小的小鼠。

senses.en: How often something happens or how quickly something changes.
An amount charged or paid for a particular unit.
To judge the quality, value, or level of something.

ex.en: This hotel offers a cheaper rate during the winter.
ex.zh: 这家酒店冬季的房价更便宜。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport often experience lower rates of car ownership, reducing congestion and improving air quality.
ex.zh: 拥有可靠公共交通的城市往往汽车拥有率较低，从而减少拥堵并改善空气质量。

tip: rate可指比率或单位费用；评价某物用rate。

senses.en: to become aware of a fact or understand a situation
to make a hope, ambition, or possibility become real

ex.en: I suddenly realised my keys were still inside the house.
ex.zh: 我突然意识到钥匙还在屋里。

ex.en: Many students realise the importance of time management when they begin balancing academic work with paid employment.
ex.zh: 许多学生开始兼顾学业与有偿工作时，才意识到时间管理的重要性。

col: realise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
realise your potential｜发挥你的潜能
tip: 英式常写realise，美式写realize；可接that从句。

senses.en: The way things actually are, rather than imagined or wished.
Something that actually exists or happens.

ex.en: The holiday looked perfect, but reality was quite different.
ex.zh: 这次假期看起来很完美，但实际情况却大不相同。

ex.en: Although remote work offers flexibility, the reality is that many employees struggle to separate work from personal life.
ex.zh: 虽然远程工作带来了灵活性，但现实是许多员工难以将工作与个人生活分开。

tip: in reality意为“实际上”；a reality指已实现的事。

senses.en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly
To make a hope happen or achieve possible success

ex.en: I realized I had left my keys at home.
ex.zh: 我意识到自己把钥匙落在家里了。

ex.en: Affordable training can help young people realize their potential and gain access to more rewarding careers.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训能帮助年轻人发挥潜力，获得更有发展前景的工作。

col: realize your potential｜发挥你的潜力
tip: 英式也拼作realise；意识到某事可接that从句。

senses.en: Fair and sensible, showing good judgement.
Not too expensive.
Acceptable in quality or amount, though not excellent.

ex.en: Your suggestion sounds reasonable, so let's try it tomorrow.
ex.zh: 你的建议听起来很合理，我们明天试试吧。

ex.en: Employers should set reasonable targets that encourage productivity without placing excessive pressure on their staff.
ex.zh: 雇主应设定合理目标，在提高生产效率的同时避免给员工施加过大压力。

tip: 形容价格时指公道、不贵，不一定是非常便宜。

senses.en: to identify someone or something known from before
to accept or understand that something is true or important
to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements

ex.en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
ex.zh: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。

ex.en: Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

senses.en: Identify someone or something known or seen before.
Accept or understand that something is true or important.
Officially accept someone's status, qualifications, or achievements.

ex.en: I recognized my old teacher by her familiar laugh.
ex.zh: 我听到熟悉的笑声，认出了以前的老师。

ex.en: Employers should recognize the value of practical experience when assessing candidates who lack formal qualifications.
ex.zh: 评估缺乏正式学历或资质的求职者时，雇主应认可实践经验的价值。

col: recognize the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: 英式也常拼作recognise；表示“认出”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: return to health or a normal condition after difficulty
get back something lost, stolen, or spent

ex.en: It took several days to recover from the flu.
ex.zh: 流感过后，花了好几天才康复。

ex.en: Local economies often recover more quickly when governments provide timely support for small businesses.
ex.zh: 政府及时为小企业提供支持时，当地经济往往恢复得更快。

col: recover from an illness｜病后康复
recover lost data｜恢复丢失的数据
tip: 从疾病或挫折中恢复用recover from。

senses.en: to process used materials so they can be used again

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
ex.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

ex.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。

senses.en: made from waste materials processed for use again

ex.en: This notebook is made entirely from recycled paper.
ex.zh: 这本笔记本完全由再生纸制成。

ex.en: Using recycled materials in construction can reduce demand for natural resources and limit waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 在建筑中使用再生材料，可以减少对自然资源的需求，减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物。

tip: recycled 指已回收再制；recyclable 指可回收。

senses.en: the process of turning waste into materials usable again
waste materials collected to be processed and used again

ex.en: Our building has separate bins for recycling and food waste.
ex.zh: 我们这栋楼分别设有回收物桶和厨余垃圾桶。

ex.en: Effective recycling programmes require convenient collection services as well as clear public guidance on sorting household waste.
ex.zh: 有效的回收利用计划既需要便利的收集服务，也需要向公众明确说明如何分类生活垃圾。

tip: 通常不可数；表示回收活动或待回收的物品。

senses.en: To make something smaller or less in amount or degree.

ex.en: We can reduce waste by using our leftovers.
ex.zh: 我们可以利用剩饭剩菜来减少浪费。

ex.en: Governments should invest in renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions and improve long-term energy security.
ex.zh: 政府应投资可再生能源，以减少碳排放并改善长期能源安全。

tip: reduce by接减少量；reduce to接减少后的量。

senses.en: mention someone or something, or have them as the meaning
look at a source to find information
send someone or something elsewhere for expert help or consideration

ex.en: Please refer to the map inside your guidebook.
ex.zh: 请查阅你的旅行指南里的地图。

ex.en: Doctors may refer patients to specialists when their symptoms require more detailed investigation or treatment.
ex.zh: 当患者的症状需要更详细的检查或治疗时，医生可能会将其转诊给专科医生。

col: refer to a report｜查阅或提及报告
refer to something as｜将某物称为
refer someone to a specialist｜将某人转诊给专科医生
tip: 常接to；过去式referred，分词referring。

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

senses.en: To put information on an official list
An official list or record of people or things
To show or record an amount on a measuring instrument

ex.en: You can register for swimming lessons at the pool.
ex.zh: 你可以在泳池报名参加游泳课。

ex.en: Residents should be able to register for local healthcare services online, reducing unnecessary travel and administrative delays.
ex.zh: 居民应能在线登记使用当地医疗服务，以减少不必要的出行和行政延误。

col: register for a course｜报名课程
register to vote｜登记成为选民
register a complaint｜正式提出投诉
tip: 报名课程用register for；登记做某事用register to do。

senses.en: to feel sorry about something that happened or was done
sadness about a past action, decision, or situation

ex.en: I regret leaving my umbrella at home this morning.
ex.zh: 我后悔今天早上把伞留在了家里。

ex.en: Graduates may regret choosing a career solely for its salary if the work provides little personal satisfaction.
ex.zh: 如果工作难以带来个人满足感，毕业生可能会后悔仅凭薪水选择职业。

col: regret doing something｜后悔做过某事
tip: regret doing指后悔做过；regret to say指遗憾告知。

senses.en: connected with something in some way
belonging to the same family

ex.en: These two problems are related to the same broken pipe.
ex.zh: 这两个问题都与同一根破裂的管道有关。

ex.en: Many health problems are closely related to poor housing conditions and limited access to nutritious food.
ex.zh: 许多健康问题与恶劣的住房条件及难以获取营养食物密切相关。

col: related by marriage｜有姻亲关系的
tip: 常用be related to；to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: a connection between people, things, or ideas
a person who belongs to your family

ex.en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
ex.zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。

ex.en: Researchers are examining the relation between access to green spaces and mental health in urban communities.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在考察城市社区中绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

col: relations between countries｜国家间的关系
tip: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

senses.en: A person connected to you by blood or marriage.
Judged by comparison rather than by a fixed standard.

ex.en: A relative brought us homemade bread during the holidays.
ex.zh: 假期里，一位亲戚给我们带来了自制面包。

ex.en: The relative cost of public transport influences whether residents choose buses over private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通的相对费用会影响居民是否选择公交车而非私家车。

tip: 作名词指亲属；作形容词常与to连用表示比较。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: making you feel calm and free from stress

ex.en: A warm bath is wonderfully relaxing after a busy day.
ex.zh: 忙碌一天后，泡个温水澡让人格外放松。

ex.en: Access to relaxing green spaces may improve mental wellbeing among residents of densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能前往令人放松的绿地，可能有助于改善人口密集城区居民的心理健康。

tip: relaxing形容事物令人放松；relaxed形容人感到放松。

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
ex.zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。

ex.en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
ex.zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。

tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

senses.en: To speak or act officially for someone or a group.
To stand for or show someone or something.
To amount to something or form part of a whole.

ex.en: My classmates chose me to represent them at the meeting.
ex.zh: 同学们选我代表他们参加会议。

ex.en: Elected councils should represent the interests of all residents, including those from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 民选议会应代表所有居民的利益，包括弱势群体的利益。

col: represent someone's interests｜代表某人的利益
represent a significant proportion｜占很大比例
tip: represent是动词；on behalf of是“代表”的介词短语。

senses.en: Something that must be done, possessed, or provided
Something needed for a particular purpose

ex.en: Wearing a helmet is a requirement at this skatepark.
ex.zh: 在这个滑板公园必须戴头盔。

ex.en: Clear entry requirements help prospective students assess whether they are adequately prepared for university courses.
ex.zh: 明确的入学要求有助于有意申请的学生判断自己是否已为大学课程做好充分准备。

col: a legal requirement｜法律规定的要求
tip: 满足要求用meet requirements，不用reach。

senses.en: To save someone or something from danger or difficulty.
An act of saving someone or something from danger.

ex.en: Firefighters rescued a kitten from the roof this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，消防员从屋顶救下了一只小猫。

ex.en: Coastal communities need well-equipped teams to rescue residents when severe flooding blocks roads and damages homes.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要装备精良的队伍，在严重洪灾阻断道路、损坏房屋时营救居民。

col: rescue someone from｜从……中救出某人
come to the rescue｜前来解围
tip: 常用rescue sb from sth，表示从险境中救出某人。

senses.en: Careful study aimed at discovering facts or developing knowledge.
To study a subject carefully to discover information.

ex.en: I did some research before choosing my new bicycle.
ex.zh: 挑选新自行车之前，我做了一番调查。

ex.en: Research into renewable energy can help governments develop cleaner and more reliable sources of electricity.
ex.zh: 对可再生能源的研究可以帮助政府开发更清洁、更可靠的电力来源。

tip: 名词通常不可数；说a study，不说a research。

senses.en: Someone who studies a subject carefully to discover new information.

ex.en: The researcher carefully examined the leaf under a microscope.
ex.zh: 研究人员用显微镜仔细观察了这片叶子。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces influences the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

col: a team of researchers｜一组研究人员
tip: researcher可数；research作名词通常不可数。

senses.en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available.
A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.

ex.en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
ex.zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。

ex.en: Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.
ex.zh: 一些居民担心噪声污染加剧，对拟议中的机场扩建持保留意见。

tip: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

senses.en: Something useful that people or organisations can draw on.
Material that provides information or support for learning.
To supply an organisation or activity with necessary support.

ex.en: Our village shares its water resources during dry summers.
ex.zh: 在干旱的夏季，我们村会共享水资源。

ex.en: Governments should manage natural resources carefully to balance economic development with long-term environmental protection.
ex.zh: 政府应谨慎管理自然资源，以平衡经济发展与长期环境保护。

tip: 资源总称常用复数resources；动词意为提供资源。

senses.en: Admiration for someone or consideration for their rights and feelings.
To value someone or follow a rule or agreement.
A particular feature or aspect of something.

ex.en: She showed respect by listening without interrupting her colleague.
ex.zh: 她认真倾听，没有打断同事，以此表达尊重。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to respect different opinions while evaluating the evidence behind each argument.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生尊重不同观点，同时评估每种论点背后的证据。

tip: 名词常接for；动词直接接宾语，不加for。

senses.en: The duty to manage something or answer for its results.
A task or duty that you are expected to handle.

ex.en: Feeding the dog is your responsibility this weekend.
ex.zh: 这个周末喂狗是你的责任。

ex.en: Governments and businesses share responsibility for reducing waste, but individuals also have an important role to play.
ex.zh: 政府和企业共同承担减少废物的责任，但个人也发挥着重要作用。

tip: 泛指责任常不可数；具体职责可数；后常接for。

senses.en: having a duty to manage or look after something
being the cause of something, especially something bad
sensible and trustworthy in your actions and decisions

ex.en: I'm responsible for feeding our cat every morning.
ex.zh: 我负责每天早晨喂我们家的猫。

ex.en: Governments are responsible for ensuring that all children have access to safe and affordable education.
ex.zh: 政府有责任确保所有儿童都能接受安全且负担得起的教育。

col: hold someone responsible｜认定某人应担责
tip: responsible for后接名词或动名词；to后接上级。

senses.en: to tell a story or describe events again

ex.en: My grandmother retells her favourite story every winter.
ex.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都会再讲一遍她最喜欢的故事。

ex.en: Asking students to retell a story in their own words can improve comprehension and speaking skills.
ex.zh: 让学生用自己的话复述故事，可以提高理解能力和口语技能。

col: retell in your own words｜用自己的话复述
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为retold。

senses.en: To stop working permanently, usually because of age.
To leave a competition before finishing it.

ex.en: My aunt plans to retire and spend more time gardening.
ex.zh: 我姑姑打算退休，多花些时间种花种菜。

ex.en: As life expectancy increases, some governments encourage people to retire later to reduce pressure on pension systems.
ex.zh: 随着预期寿命延长，一些政府鼓励人们推迟退休，以减轻养老金制度的压力。

col: retire from a race｜退出比赛
tip: retire是动词；“退休”这一名词用retirement。

senses.en: An account giving an opinion of a book, product, or performance.
A careful examination to assess something or consider changes.
To examine, study again, or give an opinion about something.

ex.en: Her review convinced me to read the whole novel.
ex.zh: 她的书评让我决定读完整部小说。

ex.en: Governments should regularly review housing policies to ensure that affordable accommodation remains available to low-income families.
ex.zh: 政府应定期审查住房政策，确保低收入家庭仍能获得负担得起的住所。

tip: 复习在美式英语中常用review，英式常用revise。

senses.en: To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚我得复习，准备生物考试。

ex.en: Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.
ex.zh: 政府应修订过时的住房政策，确保年轻家庭仍能获得负担得起的住房。

col: revise for an exam｜复习备考
tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: Studying material again to prepare for an examination
The process or result of changing something to improve it

ex.en: I do my revision at the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的餐桌旁复习。

ex.en: Regular revision helps students retain knowledge more effectively than studying intensively just before an examination.
ex.zh: 定期复习比考前突击学习更能帮助学生牢固掌握知识。

tip: 复习义主要用于英式英语；美式常用review。

senses.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.
To give something to someone for their efforts or help.

ex.en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
ex.zh: 我们给了小狗一块零食作为奖励。

ex.en: Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.
ex.zh: 学校应奖励持续的努力，而不是只关注成绩最好的学生。

col: reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人
tip: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

senses.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest
Ready for a particular action or development

ex.en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
ex.zh: 这些熟桃子闻起来很香，吃起来很甜。

ex.en: With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 随着公众支持度上升，政府加大可再生能源投资的时机已经成熟。

col: ripe for change｜变革时机成熟的
the time is ripe｜时机已经成熟
tip: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。

senses.en: the possibility that something harmful or unpleasant will happen
do something despite the possibility of harm or loss

ex.en: Wear sturdy shoes to reduce the risk of slipping.
ex.zh: 穿结实的鞋子可以降低滑倒的风险。

ex.en: Governments should assess the risk of flooding before approving new housing developments near rivers.
ex.zh: 政府在批准河流附近的新住宅开发项目之前，应评估洪水风险。

tip: risk后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: To take money or property illegally from someone or somewhere.
To unfairly take away something valuable or important.

ex.en: Someone tried to rob the shop near our house.
ex.zh: 有人试图抢劫我们家附近的商店。

ex.en: Long working hours can rob parents of valuable opportunities to spend time with their children.
ex.zh: 过长的工作时间可能使父母失去与孩子共度时光的宝贵机会。

col: rob someone of something｜抢走某人某物
rob someone of opportunities｜剥夺某人的机会
tip: rob接人或地点；steal接被偷的物品。

senses.en: A vehicle driven forward by powerful gases, often into space
Rise or increase very quickly

ex.en: We watched the rocket rise above the clouds.
ex.zh: 我们看着火箭升到云层上方。

ex.en: As housing demand continues to grow, rents may rocket in cities with limited space for new development.
ex.zh: 随着住房需求持续增长，新开发空间有限的城市可能出现租金飞涨。

tip: 作动词常描述价格等猛涨，比increase语气更强。

senses.en: The function or responsibility someone or something has.
A character played by an actor in a performance.

ex.en: My role is to welcome guests at the door.
ex.zh: 我的职责是在门口迎接客人。

ex.en: Public libraries play an important role in providing equal access to information and educational resources.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆在提供平等获取信息和教育资源的机会方面发挥着重要作用。

col: play a role in｜在……中起作用
take on a role｜承担职责
tip: 表示“在……中起作用”用play a role in。

senses.en: a loving relationship or the excitement and affection surrounding love
a story or film mainly about love

ex.en: Their romance began during a walking holiday in the mountains.
ex.zh: 他们的恋情始于一次山间徒步假期。

ex.en: Popular films often portray romance in idealised ways, which may shape young people's expectations of relationships.
ex.zh: 流行电影常以理想化的方式描绘爱情，这可能影响年轻人对恋爱关系的期待。

col: a whirlwind romance｜迅速发展的恋情
tip: 泛指爱情常不可数；指一段恋情或一部作品可数。

senses.en: connected with love or expressing loving feelings
seeing things as more beautiful or exciting than they really are
someone strongly influenced by love, imagination, or idealistic hopes

ex.en: They enjoyed a romantic dinner beside the quiet lake.
ex.zh: 他们在宁静的湖边享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

ex.en: Advertisements often present a romantic image of rural life while ignoring limited services and employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 广告常把乡村生活描绘得很美好，却忽视了服务和就业机会不足的问题。

col: a romantic view of｜对……的理想化看法
tip: 除爱情义外，也可指把现实想得过于美好。

senses.en: A circular road junction where traffic travels around a central island.
Not following the most direct route or way of speaking.
A rotating platform that children sit or stand on.

ex.en: Take the second exit at the roundabout near the park.
ex.zh: 在公园附近的环岛从第二个出口驶出。

ex.en: Replacing a busy junction with a roundabout may improve traffic flow and reduce serious collisions.
ex.zh: 将繁忙的交叉路口改为环岛可能改善车流，并减少严重碰撞事故。

col: take a roundabout route｜走迂回路线
in a roundabout way｜以迂回的方式
tip: 作形容词指不直接，如a roundabout answer。

senses.en: a way taken to get from one place to another
to send someone or something along a particular path

ex.en: We took a different route home to avoid traffic.
ex.zh: 我们换了一条路线回家，以避开拥堵。

ex.en: Expanding bus routes to rural communities would improve access to employment and essential public services.
ex.zh: 将公交线路延伸至农村社区，有助于居民获得就业机会和基本公共服务。

tip: 美式也读 /raʊt/；route 强调行进路线。

senses.en: The activity or sport of moving a boat with oars.

ex.en: My sister goes rowing on the lake every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六都去湖上划船。

ex.en: Schools that offer rowing can help students develop physical fitness, coordination, and a strong sense of teamwork.
ex.zh: 开设赛艇课程的学校可以帮助学生增强体能、协调能力和团队意识。

tip: 划船的row读/rəʊ/；争吵的row读/raʊ/。

senses.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
A member of a royal family.

ex.en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假时参观了王宫。

ex.en: Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 一些王室住所向游客开放，所得收入有助于保护历史建筑。

tip: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

senses.en: A team sport involving carrying, passing, and kicking an oval ball

ex.en: My brother plays rugby every Saturday with his friends.
ex.zh: 我哥哥每周六都和朋友们打英式橄榄球。

ex.en: Schools offering rugby should provide suitable coaching and safety equipment to reduce the risk of injuries.
ex.zh: 开设英式橄榄球课程的学校应提供适当的指导和安全装备，以降低受伤风险。

tip: 通常指英式橄榄球，不等于美式橄榄球。

senses.en: The feeling of being unhappy, especially after loss or disappointment.

ex.en: She felt a deep sadness when her friend moved away.
ex.zh: 朋友搬走时，她感到深深的难过。

ex.en: Regular social contact can help reduce feelings of sadness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与人交往有助于减轻独居老年人的悲伤情绪。

col: a sense of sadness｜一种悲伤感
tip: 通常作不可数名词；a sense of sadness指一种悲伤感。

senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
ex.zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。

ex.en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
ex.zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。

col: for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑
tip: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

senses.en: Travel across water in a boat or ship.
A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.

ex.en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
ex.zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。

ex.en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。

col: sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋
tip: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。

senses.en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats

ex.en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
ex.zh: 水手把船牢牢地系在码头上。

ex.en: Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.
ex.zh: 现代导航技术帮助海员避开危险水域，但实践经验对海上安全仍至关重要。

col: a crew of sailors｜一组船员
tip: 指在船上工作或驾驶帆船的人，不泛指乘客。

senses.en: a fish with pink flesh, or its flesh as food
having a pink colour with a slight orange shade

ex.en: We watched a salmon leap up the rocky stream.
ex.zh: 我们看着一条鲑鱼在多石的溪流中跃向上游。

ex.en: Dams can disrupt salmon migration, so river management should consider both energy production and wildlife protection.
ex.zh: 水坝可能阻碍鲑鱼洄游，因此河流管理应兼顾能源生产与野生动物保护。

tip: l不发音；指鱼时单复数同形，指鱼肉时不可数。

senses.en: covered with sand or containing a lot of sand
light yellowish brown in colour, especially describing hair

ex.en: We left our shoes beside the sandy path.
ex.zh: 我们把鞋放在了沙地小路旁。

ex.en: Sandy soils often require careful irrigation because they retain less water than soils with more clay.
ex.zh: 沙质土壤通常需要精心灌溉，因为其保水能力弱于黏土含量较高的土壤。

tip: sandy既可形容多沙的地面，也可形容浅黄褐色头发。

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

ex.en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
ex.zh: 我对这双鞋很满意，穿着特别合脚。

ex.en: Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.
ex.zh: 对工作条件感到满意的员工更有可能留在同一家机构。

tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

senses.en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used
money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs

ex.en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
ex.zh: 买月票让我省下了一笔实用的开支。

ex.en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
ex.zh: 从长远来看，投资高效供暖系统能显著降低家庭能耗。

tip: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。

senses.en: to make someone feel frightened
a sudden feeling or period of fear

ex.en: Please knock gently so you don't scare the baby.
ex.zh: 请轻轻敲门，别吓到宝宝。

ex.en: Misleading reports about food safety can scare consumers and damage public confidence in local producers.
ex.zh: 有关食品安全的误导性报道可能吓到消费者，并损害公众对本地生产商的信任。

col: give someone a scare｜吓某人一跳
tip: scared形容人感到害怕；scary形容事物吓人。

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

ex.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
ex.zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。

ex.en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。

tip: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

senses.en: The natural features of a place considered for their beauty.
Painted backgrounds and structures that create a play's setting.

ex.en: We stopped by the lake to admire the scenery.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边停下来欣赏风景。

ex.en: Protecting natural scenery can attract responsible tourism while preserving valuable habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 保护自然风景可以吸引负责任的旅游活动，同时为当地野生动物保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: scenery是不可数名词，不说a scenery或sceneries。

senses.en: a plan showing when activities or events will happen
to arrange for something to happen at a particular time

ex.en: My busy schedule leaves little time for cooking during weekdays.
ex.zh: 工作日里，我繁忙的日程几乎不给做饭留下时间。

ex.en: Universities should schedule examinations carefully to give students sufficient time for revision and recovery between assessments.
ex.zh: 大学应合理安排考试，让学生在各项考核之间有足够的复习和休息时间。

tip: 英音开头通常为/ʃ/，美音为/sk/；on schedule指准时。

senses.zh: 科学的；符合科学方法的
senses.en: relating to science or using methods based on evidence

ex.en: Our class used scientific methods to test the water.
ex.zh: 我们班用科学方法检测了水质。

ex.en: Governments should rely on scientific evidence when developing policies to protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府在制定保护公众健康的政策时，应依据科学证据。

tip: scientific强调科学依据，不等于仅仅有条理。

senses.en: A small wheeled platform with handlebars, ridden standing up.
A small motorcycle with a low platform for your feet.

ex.en: The child pushed her scooter along the smooth path.
ex.zh: 那个孩子蹬着滑板车沿着平坦的小路前进。

ex.en: Shared electric scooter schemes may reduce short car journeys if cities provide safe routes and suitable parking areas.
ex.zh: 如果城市提供安全路线和合适的停车区域，共享电动滑板车项目可能减少短途驾车出行。

col: ride a scooter｜骑滑板车或踏板摩托车
a motor scooter｜踏板式摩托车
tip: 可指站着骑的滑板车，也可指踏板式小摩托。

senses.en: To give a loud, high cry from strong emotion.
A loud, high cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement.

ex.en: The children screamed with excitement as the ride began.
ex.zh: 游乐设施一启动，孩子们就兴奋地尖叫起来。

ex.en: Residents complain that visitors scream late at night, disturbing sleep and reducing the neighbourhood's quality of life.
ex.zh: 居民抱怨游客深夜尖叫，扰人睡眠，降低了社区的生活质量。

col: let out a scream｜发出一声尖叫
tip: scream强调声音尖厉；shout只强调喊得响。

senses.en: an artwork made by carving, shaping, or assembling materials
the art of creating solid forms from materials

ex.en: A bronze sculpture of a horse stands outside the library.
ex.zh: 图书馆外矗立着一座马的青铜雕塑。

ex.en: Public sculpture can strengthen a city's cultural identity while making art accessible to people outside traditional galleries.
ex.zh: 公共雕塑能增强城市的文化认同，同时让传统美术馆之外的人们也能接触艺术。

tip: 指艺术门类不可数；指一件作品可数。

senses.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.
Less important than something else.

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。

ex.en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。

tip: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

senses.en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.

ex.en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
ex.zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。

ex.en: Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 其次，扩大公共交通覆盖范围可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地获得就业机会。

tip: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
ex.zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。

ex.en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: Protection against danger, crime, loss, or unwanted access
People or activities responsible for protecting a place
Freedom from worries about losing money, work, or essential support

ex.en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
ex.zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。

ex.en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
ex.zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

tip: security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

senses.en: A small part of a plant that can grow into another.
Put seeds into soil so that plants will grow.

ex.en: She planted each seed in a small clay pot.
ex.zh: 她把每一粒种子种进一个小陶盆里。

ex.en: Protecting seed diversity helps farmers adapt to changing climates and reduces the risk of widespread crop failure.
ex.zh: 保护种子多样性有助于农民适应气候变化，并降低大范围作物歉收的风险。

col: plant a seed｜种下一粒种子
tip: sow seeds指播种；seedling指已经发芽的幼苗。

senses.en: Choose someone or something carefully from available options.
Carefully chosen for special quality or suitability.

ex.en: Please select a fresh apple from the basket.
ex.zh: 请从篮子里挑选一个新鲜的苹果。

ex.en: Universities should select applicants using a range of criteria rather than relying entirely on examination results.
ex.zh: 大学应依据多种标准选拔申请者，而非完全依赖考试成绩。

col: select from a list｜从列表中选择
select someone for a role｜选某人担任角色
a select group｜精选的一群人
tip: select 比 choose 正式，常强调仔细挑选。

senses.en: Caring about your own needs without considering other people

ex.en: It was selfish to take the whole cake.
ex.zh: 把整个蛋糕拿走太自私了。

ex.en: Selfish behaviour in shared housing can create tension and undermine trust among residents over time.
ex.zh: 合租住房中的自私行为会造成矛盾，并逐渐损害住户之间的信任。

col: selfish of someone｜某人这样做很自私
tip: 评价某人的行为用It is selfish of sb to do。

senses.en: a person or business that sells something

ex.en: The seller wrapped the vase carefully before handing it over.
ex.zh: 卖家仔细包好花瓶后才递过来。

ex.en: Online marketplaces should require each seller to provide accurate product information and clear policies for returns.
ex.zh: 网络交易平台应要求每个卖家提供准确的产品信息和明确的退货政策。

tip: seller侧重交易中的卖方，不一定是店内售货员。
